method: Real chunks (apx) queried by the unchanged World.getEntitiesWithinAABBExcludingEntity; the unchanged Explosion.doExplosionA (size 4, no exploder) over 400 scenes of 3-8 real entities (item, orb, arrow, primed TNT, ender crystal, a player added first) near a chunk corner and slice border, some moved across a border after they were added. Each attackEntityFrom records its index (when not dead) and runs the real method; an ender crystal's real attackEntityFrom runs its createExplosion(null, .., 6) inline, whose doExplosionA is recorded one level deeper.
